captions: Five Quilts collectively designed by members of the Design Displacement Group
Divider Pages Introducing the five Acts of the Opera
No Exit’ is a generative work that explores a post-signature methodology. A
system running off HTML, JavaScript, and code libraries generates arias, librettos,
and dialogue from a database of sound and voice recordings. In five acts, music is
generated by DDG and synchronized with videos and constructed images. In this
framework, we contrast the different positions of DDG members and explore the
functional and organizational aspects of the shift in design.
Screen Installation at the Graphic Design Festival Scotland
Research: Digital Campfire van Eyck Academy
